title: Historic Sugar Mill Ruins | St. John USVI History Tour
description: Tucked into the rainforest, this stone sugar mill ruin with its arched brick oven is one of the most fascinating historic sites in St. John, US Virgin Islands. Exploring old plantation ruins is a must for any #StJohn history walk or #USVI heritage tour, offering a quiet glimpse into island history between hikes and beach days.
